llm_fields.description: The scheme provides a monthly stipend of Rs 5,000 for four years to law graduates from SC/ST communities who are residents of Karnataka, to help them practice law and undergo training under senior advocates.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicant must be a resident of Karnataka, belong to the SC/ST community, have a family income not exceeding Rs 2 lakh per annum, be at most 40 years old, hold a law degree from a recognized university, and have completed a 3‑year or 5‑year law course.
